text.description_html:
Satin Stainless Steel 6 Inches Wide and 34 Inches Long Kick Plate

Common size door kick plates primarily used in restaurants, warehouses and stores, but are popular in homes as well. Made of .050" thick high quality stainless steel for longevity. The Kick Plate is 6" wide and 34" long. It is made out of 304 stainless steel with a satin stainless steel finish. Packaged with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation.

Also Available: 8" x 34" Stainless Steel Kick Plate, 10" x 34" Stainless Steel Kick Plate and other size Door Kick Plates

Specifications of the 6 x 34 Stainless Steel Kick Plate:

  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Plate Height: 6"
  • Plate Width: 34"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Mounting Holes: 10
  • Packaged with stainless mounting screws.
  • KP634U32D Dimensions (PDF)

Note: Kick Plates are typically the width of the door less 2 inches. If your door is 36 inches wide you would install a 34 inch wide kick plate. Please measure your door/s for proper fit.
